title: LMNL Tenant Theme (v1)
description: Self-contained runtime theme for one tenant/brand. colors/typography keys are bare semantic token names applied as --{key}. Mirrors the TenantThemeDelta TypeScript interface in lmnl-design-system.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version for the file shape. Recommended: 1.

tenantId.description: Stable tenant key. Must equal the tenant folder name and the app's organisationId.

colors.description: Semantic color tokens. Key = bare token name without '--' (e.g. 'primary'); value = a CSS color or var() reference.

typography.description: Typography token overrides. Key = bare token name without '--'.

branding.description: Brand assets. Values are filenames relative to the tenant's assets/ folder (or absolute URLs).
